items.what: Directory loading must only pick up files ending in .conf, ignoring other files (e.g. file2.conf.disabled)
Files inside the directory must be read in a deterministic order (glob/sorted) so 'later overrides earlier' precedence works within a directory

reason: The instruction covers directory support and precedence, but the tests additionally require filtering to only *.conf files inside a directory, a new filtering criterion the instruction never states (a minimal 'load all files in the directory' fix would fail test_load_directory_only_conf_files). File ordering within the directory is mechanical and guessable.
